text:
Theo P: hey all, excited to start today. two small issues: my Okta shows MFA enrolled but when I try to sign into internal apps it prompts for "Unknown authenticator". Also my 1Password invite went to my contractor email (theo.contractor@gmail.com) instead of theo.p@redwood.dev. who do I ping?

Lina (IT): welcome Theo! For 1Password ping People Ops (Harper). For the Okta message can you tell me what MFA method you enrolled? passkey, phone, or TOTP?

Theo P: I did TOTP in the browser and it succeeded according to the widget. I copied the secret into 1Password while trying to set it up. But app logins still kick me to a fallback MFA page.

Harper (People Ops): hi Theo  sorry about the invite slip. I'll revoke the contractor invite and send a new seat to theo.p@redwood.dev right away. Confirm that's the email you want.

Theo P: yes please send to theo.p@redwood.dev. thanks Harper.

Samira (Security): quick flag: sometimes when a token is generated while a contractor account was attached we see an authn mismatch. Lina, could the TOTP secret have been tied to the wrong account during provisioning?

Lina (IT): possible. I'm pulling your Okta authn logs now. IT Support Bot: created ticket #INC-2233 "New hire Theo - Okta: unknown authenticator + wrong 1Password email" assigned Lina (IT).

Lina (IT): I see two enrollments within 10 minutes: one for theo.contractor@gmail.com and one for theo.p@redwood.dev. Looks like the initial invite on the onboarding form used the contractor email. I'll deprovision the contractor authenticator and re-issue a fresh TOTP secret for your corporate account. That should clear the "unknown authenticator" error.

Theo P: thanks. I didn't realize the recruiter used my personal email on the form. sorry for the extra work.

Harper (People Ops): revoked the contractor 1Password invite and sent a new seat to theo.p@redwood.dev. You should get it in a minute.

Lina (IT): Ok done with deprovision and pushed a new TOTP secret to your corporate Okta profile. When you set it up, don't reuse the old secret. Try sign-in again after enrolling.

Theo P: got the 1Password invite and set up MFA with the new secret. Logging into the internal app now: success! thanks everyone :heart:

Marc L: welcome aboard Theo :tada: ping me for repo access and I'll add you to the right teams once People Ops confirms your corporate email.

Theo P: will do, really appreciate the quick response folks.
